description: Modify an open cart before checkout. op: 'add' appends items, 'remove' drops items by 0-based index, 'set' replaces the full item list, 'clear' empties the cart. Merges customer details (name, email, phone) via the customer field. Call get_cart afterwards to confirm. Cannot modify a cart that already has a checkout in progress.

customer.description: Customer details (name, email, phone, address, city) merged into the cart.

email.description: Real customer email, checked before checkout creation

name.description: Real customer name, checked before checkout creation

phone.description: South African phone number, checked before checkout creation

indices.description: Item indices to remove (0-based) when op='remove'

items.description: Items for add or set. Each needs product_id, width_mm, height_mm, colour and mount_type.

colour.description: Exact available colour; validate with configure_product before adding

finish.description: Optional pricing finish for aluminium Venetians

mount_type.description: Use inside for recess fit or outside for face fix

product_id.description: product_id returned by search_catalog or lookup_catalog

product_name.description: Optional; server resolves the catalogue name

total_price_zar.description: Optional, ignored: server recalculates all totals

unit_price_zar.description: Optional, ignored: server recalculates all prices

op.description: add appends items, remove drops the items at the given indices, set replaces the whole item list, clear empties the cart. Default set.

name: update_cart
